2.translation: These are the verses of the clear Book.

3.translation: Perhaps you[2] will grieve yourself to death because they do not believe.

4.translation: If We willed, We could send down upon them a sign from the heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in humility[3].
4.footnotes: [3] i.e., they would be compelled to believe, being humbled.

5.translation: No new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate except that they turn away from it.

6.translation: They have rejected [the Truth], soon there will come to them the consequences of their ridicule.

7.translation: Do they not see the earth, how many fine kinds of plants We grow in it?

8.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them will not believe.

9.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

10.translation: And [remember] when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people –

11.translation: the people of Pharaoh; will they not fear [the punishment of] Allah?”

12.translation: He said, “My Lord, I fear that they may reject me,

13.translation: and I will feel distressed and my tongue will not be fluent, so send Aaron along [to help me].

14.translation: Moreover, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me[4].”
14.footnotes: [4] For killing a Coptic Egyptian by mistake before becoming a prophet.

15.translation: Allah said, “Certainly not! Go, both of you, with Our signs[5]; We are with you, listening.
15.footnotes: [5] i.e., the miracles of the staff and the shining hand, given to Moses.

16.translation: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are the messengers[6] from the Lord of the worlds,
16.footnotes: [6] The singular form in Arabic denotes that they both were sent with a single message.

17.translation: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.’”

18.translation: Pharaoh said, “Did we not bring you up as a child among us, and you stayed with us several years of your life?

19.translation: Yet you did what you did[7], and you are extremely ungrateful.”
19.footnotes: [7] i.e., striking the Copt in support of a man from your people, who died as a result.

20.translation: He said, “I did it when I had no guidance.

21.translation: So I fled from you in fear. Then my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of the messengers.

22.translation: Is this a favor that you remind me with, that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?[8]
22.footnotes: [8] i.e., If you had not been cruel to the Israelites, I should not have been brought to your house for upbringing.

23.translation: Pharaoh said, “What is ‘the Lord of the worlds’?”

24.translation: Moses said, “The Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, if only you had sure faith.”

25.translation: Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear [what he just said]?”

26.translation: Moses said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.”

27.translation: Pharaoh said, “Your messenger who has been sent to you is truly insane!”

28.translation: Moses said, “Lord of the east and west and all that is between them, if only you had sense!”

29.translation: Pharaoh said, “If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison.”

30.translation: Moses said, “What if I bring you a clear proof?”

31.translation: Pharaoh said, “Bring it then if you are truthful!”

32.translation: So he threw down his staff, and suddenly it was a real serpent.

33.translation: And he drew out his hand, and it was glowing white to the beholders.

34.translation: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, “This is indeed a learned magician!

35.translation: He wants to drive you out of your land with his magic. What do you suggest?”

36.translation: They said, “Let him and his brother wait and dispatch heralds to the cities

37.translation: to bring you every learned magician.”

38.translation: So the magicians were assembled at an appointed time on a known day[9].
38.footnotes: [9] i.e., the morning of the festival day. See 20:58-59.

39.translation: And it was said to the people, “Will you join the gathering,

40.translation: so that we may follow the magicians, if they are victorious?”

41.translation: When the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, “Will there be a reward for us if we are victorious?”

42.translation: He said, “Yes, and then you will surely be of those who are close to me.”

43.translation: Moses said to them, “Throw whatever you wish to throw.”

44.translation: So they threw their ropes and staffs, and said, “By the glory of Pharaoh, it is we who will be the victorious!”

45.translation: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it swallowed up all objects of their illusion.

46.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration.

47.translation: They said, “We believe in the Lord of the worlds,

48.translation: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

49.translation: Pharaoh said, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission. Indeed, he is your master who taught you magic, but you will soon come to know. I will surely cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, then I will crucify you all.”

50.translation: They said, “No harm; we will surely return to our Lord.

51.translation: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers.”

52.translation: We inspired Moses, “Leave with My slaves by night; you will surely be pursued.”

53.translation: So Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities[10],
53.footnotes: [10] In order to prevent the emigration of the Children of Israel.

54.translation: saying, “These are but a small band,

57.translation: Thus did We drive them[11] out of their gardens and springs,

58.translation: and their treasures and splendid dwellings.

59.translation: So it was, and We made the Children of Israel to inherit them.

61.translation: When the two groups saw each other, the companions of Moses said, “We are surely overtaken!”

62.translation: Moses said, “Certainly not! My Lord is with me; He will guide me.”

63.translation: Then We inspired Moses, “Strike the sea with your staff,” so it parted, and each part became like a huge mountain.

64.translation: Then We brought the others [i.e., the pursuers] close to that place,

65.translation: and We saved Moses and all those who were with him.

67.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

68.translation: Indeed, your Lord is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

69.translation: Relate to them the story of Abraham,

70.translation: when he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”

71.translation: They said, “We worship idols and remain devoted to them.”

72.translation: He said, “Do they hear you when you call upon them?

73.translation: Or can they benefit or harm you?”

74.translation: They said, “No, but this is what we found our forefathers doing.”

75.translation: He said, “Do you see what you have been worshiping,

77.translation: Indeed, they are my enemies, except the Lord of the worlds[12],
77.footnotes: [12] As they worshiped idols in addition to worshiping Allah.

78.translation: Who created me, so He guides me;

79.translation: and it is He Who provides me with food and drink;

80.translation: and when I am ill He heals me;

81.translation: and He will cause me to die and then bring me back to life;

82.translation: and I hope that He will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgment.”

83.translation: “My Lord, grant me knowledge, and join me with the righteous,

84.translation: and grant me an honorable mention among the later generations[13],
84.footnotes: [13] Muslims invoke Allah’s blessings upon Abraham (ﷺ) along with Muhammad (ﷺ) in their daily prayers.

85.translation: and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss;

86.translation: and forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray;

87.translation: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all will be resurrected –

88.translation: the Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any avail,

89.translation: except the one who comes to Allah with a sound heart[14].”
89.footnotes: [14] A heart free from disbelief, polytheism, hypocrisy, arrogance, and show-off.

90.translation: Paradise will be brought near to the righteous,

91.translation: and Hellfire will be uncovered to those who went astray,

92.translation: and they will be told, “Where are those whom you used to worship

93.translation: other than Allah? Can they help you or even help themselves?”

94.translation: Then they will be hurled into Hell one upon another, along with those who led them astray,

95.translation: and the followers of Iblīs, all together.

96.translation: There the deviants will say while quarreling with their false deities,

98.translation: when we deemed you equal to the Lord of the worlds.

99.translation: None led us astray except the wicked.

100.translation: Now we neither have any intercessors,

102.translation: If only we had a chance to return, we would be among the believers.”

103.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

104.translation: Your Lord is surely the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

105.translation: The people of Noah rejected the messengers[15]
105.footnotes: [15] For denying Noah was equal to denying all of the messengers of Allah.

106.translation: when their brother Noah said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

107.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

108.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

109.translation: I seek of you no reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds;

110.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.”

111.translation: They said, “Shall we believe in you when you are followed by the lowest people[16]?”
111.footnotes: [16] For they were mostly the poor and ordinary people, who enjoyed no position in society.

112.translation: He said, “What knowledge do I have of what they do?

113.translation: Their reckoning is only with my Lord if you realize!

114.translation: I am not going to drive the believers away.

115.translation: I am only a clear warner.”

116.translation: They said, “O Noah, if you do not desist, you will certainly be stoned.”

117.translation: He said, “My Lord, my people have rejected me.

118.translation: So judge between me and them decisively, and save me and the believers who are with me.”

119.translation: So We saved him and those who were with him in the fully laden Ark.

120.translation: Then We drowned thereafter all the rest.

121.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

122.translation: Indeed, your Lord is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

123.translation: The people of ‘Ād rejected the messengers

124.translation: when their brother Hūd said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

125.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

126.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

127.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

128.translation: Do you build a landmark[17] on every high place for no purpose?
128.footnotes: [17] They used to build lofty structures along the road to be seen by passersby, as a symbol of their wealth and power.

129.translation: And do you construct for yourselves palaces, hoping that you will live forever?

130.translation: And when you attack [others], do you attack ruthlessly?

131.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me.

132.translation: And fear the One Who has provided you with everything you know:

133.translation: Who provided you with livestock and children,

135.translation: I fear for you the punishment of a momentous day.”

136.translation: They said, “It is the same to us whether you admonish us or not.

137.translation: This is nothing but the custom of the former people,

138.translation: and we will never be punished.”

139.translation: Thus they rejected him, so We destroyed them. Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe,

140.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

141.translation: The people of Thamūd rejected the messengers

142.translation: when their brother Sālih said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

143.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

144.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

145.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

146.translation: Will you be left secure in whatever you have here,

148.translation: and in fields of crops and date palms laden with tender fruit,

149.translation: carving out houses in the mountains with great skill?

150.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me.

151.translation: And do not obey the command of the transgressors,

152.translation: those who spread corruption in the land and never do what is right.”

153.translation: They said, “You are but one of those who are bewitched!

154.translation: You are but a human like us, so bring a sign if you are one of the truthful.”

155.translation: Sālih said, “This is a she-camel[18]; she will have her share of water and you will have yours, each on a specified day.
155.footnotes: [18] That was miraculously sent to them as a sign by Allah.

156.translation: Do not touch her with harm, or you will be seized by the punishment of a horrible day.”

157.translation: But they hamstrung her, then they became regretful,

158.translation: So the punishment seized them[19]. Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.
158.footnotes: [19] They were destroyed by a violent earthquake and a blast after Sālih told them: “You have only three days to enjoy yourselves in your houses”. See 11:65. Allah says: “We sent against them a single blast, leaving them like trampled hedge-building twigs”. See 54:31.

159.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

160.translation: The people of Lot rejected the messengers,

161.translation: when their brother Lot said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

162.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

163.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

164.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

165.translation: Do you approach males with lust among all people[20],
165.footnotes: [20] i.e., Are there any creatures besides you who commit this abominable act?

166.translation: leaving the wives whom your Lord has created for you? You are but a transgressing people.”

167.translation: They said, “O Lot, If you do not desist, you will surely be expelled.”

168.translation: Lot said, “I am one of those who utterly abhor your practice.

169.translation: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequences of] what they do.”

170.translation: So We saved him and all his family,

171.translation: except an old woman who was among those who remained behind[21].
171.footnotes: [21] Lot's wife, who betrayed him by not believing and remained a disbeliever; thus, she was among those destroyed.

173.translation: and We poured down upon them a rain [of stones]. How terrible was the rain of those who were warned!

174.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

175.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

176.translation: The people of the Forest[22] rejected the messengers.
176.footnotes: [22] i.e., the people of Madyan, to whom Shu‘ayb was sent.

177.translation: When Shu‘ayb said to them, “Will you not fear Allah?

178.translation: I am a trustworthy messenger to you,

179.translation: so fear Allah, and obey me.

180.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

181.translation: Give full measure and do not be of those who defraud others,

183.translation: and do not defraud people of their goods, nor go about in the land spreading corruption.

184.translation: And fear the One Who created you and the former peoples[23].”

186.translation: You are only a human being like us, and we think you are nothing but a liar.

187.translation: So cause pieces of the sky to fall upon us, if you are of the truthful.”

188.translation: Shu‘ayb said, “My Lord knows best whatever you do.”

189.translation: Thus they rejected him, so they were seized by the punishment of the cloudy day; it was the punishment of a horrible day.

190.translation: Indeed, there is a sign in this, yet most of them would not believe.

191.translation: Your Lord is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

192.translation: This is indeed a revelation from the Lord of the worlds,

193.translation: which the Trustworthy Spirit [Gabriel] has brought down

194.translation: to your heart [O Prophet] so that you may be one of the warners,

196.translation: And it was indeed [mentioned] in the scriptures of the former peoples.

197.translation: Was it not a proof for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel recognized it [to be true][24]?
197.footnotes: [24] e.g., Abdullah ibn Salām, a Jewish scholar, accepted Islam during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ), for he knew that he came with a true message.

198.translation: If We had sent it down to any of the non-Arabs,

199.translation: and he had recited it to them[25]; still, they would not have believed in it.

200.translation: This is how We made it [i.e., disbelief] enter the hearts of the wicked.

201.translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment,

202.translation: which will come upon them suddenly when they least expect it.

203.translation: They will then say, “Can we be granted some respite?”

204.translation: Do they really seek to hasten Our punishment?

205.translation: Tell me [O Prophet] if We give them a life of ease for years,

206.translation: then there came to them what they were warned of,

207.translation: what would avail them the life of ease that they were given?

208.translation: We never destroyed any town without sending them warners,

209.translation: to admonish them, for We are never unjust.

210.translation: This [Qur’an] is not sent down by the devils[26],
210.footnotes: [26] As the disbelievers claim; rather, it is brought down by Gabriel, the Trustworthy Spirit.

211.translation: it is not for them to do this, nor is it within their capability,

212.translation: for they are strictly barred from overhearing it[27].
212.footnotes: [27] So they cannot eavesdrop on heaven. See 72:9.

213.translation: So do not call upon any other god besides Allah, lest you become of those who will be punished.

214.translation: And warn [starting with] the nearest kinsfolk,

215.translation: and lower your wing [in kindness] to the believers who follow you.

216.translation: But if they disobey you, say, “I disown what you do.”

217.translation: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

218.translation: Who sees you when you stand up [for prayer],

219.translation: and your movements among those who prostrate.

220.translation: Indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

221.translation: Shall I inform you upon who the devils descend?

222.translation: They descend upon every sinful liar,

223.translation: who whisper hearsay in the ears, but most of them are liars.

224.translation: As for poets, they are followed by the deviants.

225.translation: Do you not see that they wander aimlessly in every valley[28],
225.footnotes: [28] Telling lies indiscriminately, praising some, and disparaging others.

226.translation: and that they say what they do not do?

227.translation: Except those who believe, do righteous deeds, remember Allah much and defend themselves[29] after being wronged. The wrongdoers will come to know what end awaits them.
227.footnotes: [29] By replying to the satire of hostile poets through poetry.
